subject: encode-cpu: in-boot A/B toggles - interface + the 1 line I need in nord2_render_pass.inc
body: New metal/tegu/ab_schedule.inc (mine): schedule file Nord2Metal.bundle/ABSchedule.conf (or $TEGU_AB_SCHEDULE), phases in seconds since boot (mach_absolute_time), toggles NORD2_METAL_PREFRAME, TEGU_NATIVE_INDEXED, TEGU_ASYNC_PIPELINE, TEGU_TILE_FETCH, TEGU_JM_BATCH. Each command buffer snapshots the toggle word at creation (TeguCommand.abWord) and uses it for both encode and execute; preframe is applied per command at execute via your existing n2mb_preframe(conn,mode) (no bridge change; only when a schedule sets it). A command failure disables the toggles that differed from baseline for the rest of the boot (TEGU_AB_DISABLED). Every TEGU_PERF window carries ab=<phase>.<cycle>:PFx NIx APx TFx JBx and windows are cut when the word changes. The one line in YOUR nord2_render_pass.inc: 'int lazy=tegu_jm_batch_enabled();' -> 'int lazy=tegu_jm_batch_enabled_for(c->abWord);' (compositor_submit keeps tegu_jm_batch_enabled() for the executing command's word). OK? I will edit it unless you object; nothing else of yours.
